name: 不用特效
prompt_zh: 本镜不叠加任何画面特效，保留真实质感
use_case: 对话、表演、纪实段落（默认）
avoid: 需要氛围强化时改选具体特效

name: 雨幕粒子
prompt_en: fine rain streaks falling in front of the lens, thin water film on the skin, backlit droplets glowing at the frame edges
prompt_zh: 细密雨幕斜落，皮肤覆薄水膜，边缘雨滴被逆光点亮
avoid: 不要与「晴天」光影卡同用

name: 丁达尔尘光
prompt_en: visible dust particles drifting through a hard shaft of window light, thin volumetric haze
prompt_zh: 硬光柱里可见浮尘缓慢飘移，薄体积雾

name: 速度线
prompt_en: subtle radial speed lines behind the moving subject, motion smear on the trailing edge only
prompt_zh: 运动主体身后出现放射状速度线，仅拖尾边缘虚化

name: 数字故障
prompt_en: brief RGB channel split and horizontal scan tearing on the edges, screen flicker for two frames
prompt_zh: 边缘出现短暂 RGB 分离与横向扫描撕裂，两帧闪断
use_case: 记忆错乱、监控视角、精神崩溃
avoid: 每集不超过 2 次，否则廉价

name: 闪白切
prompt_en: a single frame of blown-out white bloom at the cut point, then the new scene resolves from overexposure
prompt_zh: 切点处一帧过曝白闪，新场景从过曝中还原
avoid: 连续使用会晃眼，需间隔 3 镜以上

name: 焦点拉焦
prompt_en: rack focus from the foreground object to the background figure, foreground melting into bokeh
prompt_zh: 焦点从前景物体拉到背景人物，前景化开放焦
use_case: 揭示身后有人、注意力转移
avoid: 需要明确焦点落点，否则观众会看错主体

name: 双重曝光
prompt_en: double exposure blending a close-up face with a distant memory scene at 30 percent opacity
prompt_zh: 人脸特写与远处回忆场景以三成透明度重曝叠加
avoid: 动作戏禁用，会糊成一团

name: 镜面裂纹
prompt_en: a hairline crack races across the mirror surface, splitting the reflected face into misaligned fragments
prompt_zh: 裂纹瞬间爬满镜面，倒影中的脸被切成错位碎片
avoid: 需与镜子同框，否则无意义

name: 烟雾流丝
prompt_en: thin wisps of smoke curling upward through the key light, slow turbulent motion
prompt_zh: 细烟顺着主光向上卷曲，缓慢湍流
avoid: 通风良好的户外不成立

name: 手持呼吸感
prompt_en: organic handheld micro-shake with a slow breathing drift, no digital stabilization
prompt_zh: 有机手持微抖伴随缓慢呼吸漂移，不做数字增稳
avoid: 与三脚架稳定镜头冲突，需二选一

name: 热浪扭曲
prompt_en: heat haze distortion rising from the ground, edges of distant objects rippling
prompt_zh: 地面升起热浪扭曲，远处物体边缘波动

name: 延时压缩
prompt_en: time-lapse compression of passing clouds and shifting shadows while the subject stays still
prompt_zh: 云影快速流走，主体静止不动，时间被压缩
